metaDescription: Order custom tri blend pullovers in bulk. Soft, durable fabric perfect for logos. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Tri blend pullovers combine cotton, polyester, and rayon for a fabric that feels soft against the skin while holding up to daily wear. The blend also provides a smooth surface for screen printing or embroidery, making your logo stand out clearly. Whether you need hoodies for a company giveaway or 1/2-zip pullovers for a team uniform, tri blend offers a premium feel without the high price point.
heroAltText: Custom tri blend pullovers with embroidered logo on front, soft fabric blend of cotton polyester and rayon
